assay: GSE281210: bulk RNA-seq of whole bone marrow cells (S2.6.p1, FIG3); GSE281970: scRNA-seq of Lin- c-kit+ HSPCs (S2.8.p1), not analyzed here
sample_inclusion: male C57BL/6, 8 weeks old, HU for 28 days (S2.1.p1); bulk RNA-seq 3 replicates per group (FIG3)
primary_estimand: Effect of 4-week hindlimb unloading (mechanical unloading / disuse osteoporosis) vs normally loaded control on bone marrow gene expression. No exercise or training arm exists anywhere in the study.
planned_contrasts: OP-HU vs Con, whole bone marrow bulk RNA-seq (S3.3.p1, FIG3; DEG count not reported)

paper_threshold.source_locator: not stated for RNA-seq DEGs (S2.6.p1); S2.9.2.p1 p<0.05 refers to Prism t-tests

paper_results: heatmap of changed genes; GO of downregulated leukocyte-differentiation terms; Pf4 down (p=0.0002, FPKM t-test), Tgfb1 slightly down (FIG3C); Ccl3 down, Ccl5 up (FIG S2B)
